facilities.name: Gladhammars gruvor / Holländaregruvan
facilities.description: Major abandoned mine area at Käringryggen/Gladhammars gruvor. Official section text describes former cobalt and copper mining, fenced mine holes up to about 110 m deep, and a rest/info area near the high mast. Import with safety caveat: fenced mine holes and remediated contamination area; do not suggest drinking from nearby mine/Tjursbosjön water.
